subject: FastRetail POC: stakeholder map + evidence deliverables

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-12T17:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: discovery + next steps (FastRetail POC)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Objective: run a 4-week POC to validate latency/cost against your search-and-assist flows and evaluate RBAC + audit capabilities.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: (1) reliability under 200ms p95 for 512 tokens, (2) clear audit logs + retention policy, (3) predictable unit economics, and (4) demonstrated security posture (SOC2 + pen test).

Stakeholder map (AS-IS from our notes):
- Product sponsor / economic buyer: Thomas Becker (VP Engineering) — interested in TCO and SLAs.
- Technical lead: you (Samantha) and Oliver Chang (security).
- Procurement: procurement@fastretail.com.

Requested next steps: 
1) Could you confirm Thomas and Oliver are the right contacts and loop procurement if appropriate?
2) I will pull together SOC 2 summary, pen-test executive summary, and a short write-up on audit logs & data retention for your review.
3) Proposed schedule: evidence pack by EOD Friday, quick security checkpoint with Oliver next week, then procurement/contract discussion the following week.

I'll CC our security lead (Neha) and CS (Marissa) on evidence requests. If anything above needs correcting, tell me and I'll update.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all — looping in from security. Attaching the artifacts we can share immediately: 

- Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf (PDF, 420KB) — executive summary of SOC 2 Type II controls and scope.
- Attachment: pen-test-exec-summary.txt (TXT, 8KB) — high-level findings and remediation status; full report available under NDA.
- Attachment: data-retention-policy.md (MD, 3KB) — outlines default retention windows and customer controls for deletion.
- Attachment: audit-logs-sample.csv (CSV, 12KB) — sanitized sample showing metadata-level logs (timestamp, request_id, model, latency_ms).

Quick answers to Samantha's questions: 
- Audit logs: by default we capture metadata (request headers, request_id, model, token counts, latency, and a hash of the input to support replay detection). We do not store full plaintext request bodies for customers that request minimal retention; for PII-sensitive workflows we recommend customer-managed encryption keys (we support KMS).
- Retention windows: default 90 days for metadata logs; options to extend to customer-specified retention up to 7 years on Dedicated/Private plans.
- Pen-test: we can share an executive summary immediately (attached). The full penetration test report is produced by a third party and requires an NDA and a confirmed procurement track; turnaround to share full report once NDA executed is 2–3 business days.

I'll be available for a 30-minute sync with Oliver next week to walk through any controls or provide more detail. Propose Tue 3/17 or Wed 3/18 morning PST.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
